```{r global_options}
#| include: false
#| eval: true

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  error = FALSE,
  eval = TRUE,
  ## static figures (PNG, high resolution) for Typst
  dev = "png",
  dpi = 200)
options(scipen = 999)
## tables may break across pages (tinytable sets non-breakable figures by
## default)
options(tinytable_typst_multipage = TRUE)
pcg_report <- readRDS(file = "<PCGR_REPORT_OBJECT.rds>")

## main report color (tumor-control: purple, tumor-only: blue) - used for
## table headers; page chrome colors are set in typst/_theme.typ
report_color <- pcgrr:::pdf_report_color(pcg_report)
max_variants_pdf <- 25
```

```{r cover_page}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

## Cover + summary of findings - values resolved in R
## (pcgrr:::pdf_cover_values), layout in typst/_preamble.typ (pcgr-cover)
cat(pcgrr:::pdf_cover_typst(pcg_report))
```
